title: Season 1
overview: Steven Grant and Marc Spector navigate multiple identities and Egyptian gods.

episodes.title: The Goldfish Problem
episodes.overview: Steven Grant experiences blackouts and discovers a violent alternate personality.

episodes.title: Summon the Suit
episodes.overview: Steven meets Marc’s wife Layla and summons the Mr. Knight suit.

episodes.title: The Friendly Type
episodes.overview: Marc and Layla travel to Cairo to find the tomb of Ammit.

episodes.title: The Tomb
episodes.overview: Marc and Layla navigate a dangerous labyrinth and encounter Arthur Harrow.

episodes.title: Asylum
episodes.overview: Marc and Steven journey through Marc’s memories to balance the scales of justice.

episodes.title: Gods and Monsters
episodes.overview: Moon Knight and Layla unite with Khonshu to defeat Arthur Harrow and Ammit.
